premise: I liquidated my $85,000 401(k) to start an indie publishing house with my daughter, securing a 30% lifetime royalty share on every title, but she forged a rights‑reversion letter, sold a viral memoir for $1.1 million, and mailed me a $5,000 check; I retrieved our original contract from my safe‑deposit box, proved the forgery via metadata, and now run ‘Copyright of Revenge Press’ — my daughter stuffs marketing envelopes in a shirt that says ‘Plot Twist: I Stole from Mom,’ and every book’s foreword details the fraud.
